review_description: BAM Building and Electrical (www.bambuilding.com.au) bent over backward to accommodate the tight timeframe for installation at a country location and the unusual location I wanted for the inverter. The final price was even less than quoted as some of the mounting kit was not needed.It was refreshing to see that such a professional, honest and friendly team of craftsmen who obviously take pride in what they do still exist in the building industry. I highly recommend this small business to anyone considering Solar or indeed any building or renovation work.
